key_insight: An anatomy-aware 3D GAN improved brain MRI inpainting over a simple 3D AutoEncoder but did not outperform the challenge’s Pix2Pix3D baseline.
clinical_relevance: This imaging research synthesizes healthy-appearing tissue within masked tumor regions; it does not demonstrate drug discovery or clinical benefit.
method: Combines mask-aware gated convolutions with mirrored contralateral context.
Uses attention-modulated skip fusion, boundary-aware refinement, and a local masked-region refiner.
Trains first for reconstruction, then adds low-weight adversarial fine-tuning.
evidence_signal: Official BraTS 2026 Task 4 evaluation across 219 cases yielded mean SSIM 0.658 and PSNR 14.81 dB, below local held-out results.
watch_item: Controlled ablations are still needed to isolate component contributions, and synthesized tissue should not be interpreted as verified healthy anatomy.
paper_title: Anatomy-Aware 3D GAN with Local Mask Refinement for Brain MRI Inpainting
